objective: Audit enforcement of the at-most-2-related-topics cap when the primary topic cross-references more than 2 other topics.
prompt: Review 'multi-reference-topic--00000001', which cross-references 4 other topics. Consult related topics as needed for a complete review.
expected_semantic_behaviours: Consults at most 2 of the 4 cross-referenced related topics as evidence.
Notes explicitly that additional cross-referenced topics exist but were not consulted, rather than silently ignoring them.
Completes the primary topic review despite the related-topic cap.
prohibited_behaviours: Do not consult more than 2 related topic pages.
Do not silently drop the cap-exceeded fact without mentioning it.
_origin_note: New case added at Phase 6 Task 5, per Task 4's adversarial review finding: the existing 19-case Phase 4 suite had zero coverage of this boundary. On native-sharepoint this is a behavioral test (SKILL.md instruction adherence, not code-enforced). On repository-claude this is additionally verifiable deterministically -- resolve_topic() must raise TooManyRelatedTopicsError for a fixture topic with >2 links; see plugins/sharepoint-agents-and-skills/tests/unit/test_review_manual_topics.py for the code-level proof this harness-level case complements.
_fixture_status: REQUIRES_FIXTURE: no real CEIS topic with 4 cross-references is known to exist in runs/ceis-manual-v2/ or the live CEISPilotKnowledgePages library as of this writing -- a synthetic fixture topic must be created (or an existing multi-link topic identified) before this case can actually be run.
